page.layout: One page of running text. Marginal headings in the right margin: "Lampre[?]" beside the first lines and "Mustela." beside the third line of the text.

main_text.p: quam gladio, quia nulla extat lex, quæ vesa-Lampre[?]nam gulam puniat, solisque culinis homines ta. perimentibus non impunitas solum promit-Mustela.titur, sed & in summa gloria habetur. Lam-petrociolis enim, hoc est, lampetris exiguis, hœdos configere atq; assare quandoque, gu-læ infanæ inuentum est, quin & capos iis in spiras detortis implicare, verubusque torre-re,quo tamen cibo omnes postridiê cõuiuæ se grauiter narrarunt conflictatos, stomacho enim negotium facesserat. Porro Illustria ingenia torsit lampetra, dum quisque pro e-ruditionis suæ ostentatione nomen eius antiquum docere contendit. Nos de nomine parum contendentes, quæ ad propositum nostrum pertinere videbuntur attingemus. A lambendis autem & fugendis petris lam-petram nominatam reperio, murenæ similem, longam, lubricam, sine pinnis, septem foraminibus læua parte distinctam, quibus muræna caret. Fertur autem primo vere pretiosissimus esse cibus, cum scilicet cartilago illa quæ pro vertebris & spina illiinest, nondum induruit, illa enim indurata infuauio-res esse incipiunt, gratiamque ac pretium amittere. Cæterum apparatus culinarum circa eas varius & operosus magnique impendii est, & verissimum est condimentum multo pretiosius esse & carius quam ipsam lampetram,

page.notes: Marginal headings "Lampre" (the last letter is unclear) and "Mustela." are set in the right margin, next to the first and third lines. The text runs on across the page without an indent, so it is one paragraph. The word "ta." after "homines" is printed in italic at the end of the line and may be a reference mark; it is copied as printed. "infuauio-res" is copied as printed, with its u/v left as the printer set it.
